paper_metadata.title: Designing novel lightweight, high-strength and high-plasticity Tix(AlCrNb)100-x medium-entropy alloys

evidence.quote: In this study, a nonequiatomic quaternary alloy system, Tix(AlCrNb)100-x, was designed through the calculation of phase diagrams.
The structures and mechanical properties of novel lightweight medium-entropy Tix(AlNbCr)100-x alloys were investigated

Master alloys with a nominal composition of Tix(AlCrNb)100-x (x = 45-80 at%) were prepared by arc melting appropriate mixtures of 99.9 wt% Al, Ti, Cr, and Nb under an argon atmosphere accompanied by a Ti getter. Each master alloy was remelted four times to ensure homogeneity of composition. Subsequently, the master alloys were melted and cast into ingots with dimensions of 30 x 30 x 5 mm3 in a water-cooled copper mold coupled with an insulated riser.
